title: Why Chun-Li really became a cop in Street Fighter
subject: chunli
description:
Would you have gone after Bison alone? 👇

How Chun-Li's missing father turned her into Interpol's Shadaloo hunter. Spoilers for the Street Fighter series.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Chun-Li was a detective at 18, searching for one missing man.
He was her father, a police officer who taught her every kick she knew.
Then he vanished, and nobody could tell her who took him.
His old friend Gen, an aging assassin, finally gave her a name: Shadaloo, the drug empire of M. Bison.
She joined Interpol as a narcotics investigator and found Bison herself. "Stuff it, Bison! You're under arrest!"
He beat her easily and promised she would die the same way her father did.
She got up and swore she would bring Shadaloo down.
